# F25: Home’s numbers agree: every count on Home that is a link opens Goals with that number in its count line

A check of the core ([the journeys](../journeys.md)): not a journey with steps a person takes, but a script that opens pages and reports what is wrong (Faro’s `evals/finish/25-home-numbers.cjs`). A rebuild proves the same by hand or with its own script: every failure below must not happen. Each is in the script’s words; {…} is what it measured.

## What it checks

Home's numbers agree (docs/design/home/spec.md section 8, HM4). For Tunde, Rhea, Amara and Oskar on three days, every count on Home that is a link opens a Goals page whose count line says the same number. Home's last look is set to Friday 6 Nov first (the `home-seen` pref, per browser), so "Changed since" counts from a day the check knows. Not checked here: that every count on Home that isn't a link is the length of a list on Home; nor "{k} more …" links, which continue a list (their page counts the whole of it).

## What it reports as wrong

- {who} {day}: “{l.text}” and “{seen.get(l.href).text}” open {l.href} with different numbers
- {who} {day}: “{l.text}” ({l.href}) opened Goals saying “{said}”
- no “Changed since” count or “Since” link was found on any Home
